messages:
Ava Gomez: Hey team — quick thread to lock down the customer micro‑story for next week's launch. Want a one‑page + short social quote + a 20‑min interview clip we can use in the webinar. Who can greenlight the quote text?
Liam Chen: I can review product accuracy. Do we have the final metrics from infra?
Ava Gomez: Yes — P95 latency down 42% and cost per 1M tokens ~40% lower vs prior infra. I tweeted the internal benchmark deck at /files/benchmarks/Q1. Want a softer line for public copy though.
Riya Patel: I can schedule the interview with the customer. Two slots: Tues 9–9:30 PT or Wed 3–3:30 PT. Prefer a remote-recorded video + separate audio.
Jonas Park: For inbound lead routing: once published, can we route strong demo requests to Enterprise AE queue? We should add a form field: "Interested in Dedicated" boolean.
Ava Gomez: Good call. Jonas — can you send the SFDC queue ID and a simple routing map? I can add to the launch playbook.
Jonas Park: Sent in DM, but queue ID = EQ-93. Routing: demo requests -> EQ-93, press/PR -> comms, case study interest -> customer-success.
LegalBot: Heads up — customer needs an approval checkbox and signature for quotes. Please attach the consent text.
Ava Gomez: Draft consent snippet below. Can someone run quick legal check?
Ava Gomez: ```
I authorize Redwood Inference to use the following quote and my company's name/logo in marketing materials related to the product launch. I confirm that the information is not confidential.
```
LegalBot: Redline: change "not confidential" to "not marked or designated as confidential" and add a line for trademark approval.
Samira Ortiz: I have the customer's PR contact — they asked to see the final pull quote before publish. I'll get signoff by EOD tomorrow. :+1:
Riya Patel: Scheduling note — I'll book both slots and include a short interview brief. Brief will include 3 q's: 1) the problem, 2) why Redwood helped, 3) measurable impact.
Ava Gomez: For the social quote, prefer something punchy and non‑technical. Example: "Redwood cut our inference costs and kept latency predictable — a game changer." Open to edits.
Liam Chen: Suggest: "Redwood cut our inference costs by ~40% while improving tail latency — huge for customer-facing features"
Samira Ortiz: Customer prefers the punchier Ava version but ok with adding the 40% stat in the case study body.
LegalBot: Please send the final quote and the consent form to legal@redwood.ai for records. We need name, title, and timestamp of signoff.
Ava Gomez: Noted. After signoff, LaunchBot — can you kick off the asset checklist and publish workflow?
LaunchBot: Asset checklist created: 1) Case one-pager (design draft), 2) Approved quote + consent form, 3) Video clip (edited), 4) Blog draft, 5) Webinar mention + slide. ETA: 48 hours post-signoff.
Riya Patel: Small production note — we'll record at 1080p, please confirm if we should record an extra 15s b-roll for motion graphics.
Ava Gomez: Yes please — b-roll helps the social cut.
Jonas Park: After publish, can you add UTM=customer_microstory and webhook to push demo leads to EQ-93? I'll test the webhook.
Ava Gomez: Perfect. I'll update the launch doc with routing and the webinar panel note (customer available for a 5‑minute Q&A).
Samira Ortiz: Customer confirmed they can do Wed 3pm. I'll get the consent signed and drop the PDF here when done.
Ava Gomez: Thanks all — plan: Riya to record Wed 3pm, Samira to upload consent by EOD Tue, Liam to final technical review today. If all clear, LaunchBot will start asset builds Wed night. :rocket:
LaunchBot: Noted. I will ping #marketing-live on publish and create the press/webinar calendar invites after assets are ready.
Ava Gomez: Closing loop — please react with :thumbsup: when your task is done so I can move to publish stage.
